notes: Aviation brigades sent to an AO now actually move into it: once they land in Kuwait their helicopters base at the AO's FOBs and camps with a helicopter pad, which pushes the MEDEVAC and attack aviation rings forward. With Auto, an aviation brigade goes to the AO with a pad that has the fewest helicopters. Helicopters sent to an AO from the unit cart do the same, and jets sent to an AO land at Ali Al Salem and fly from there
New AO button: Bring helicopters forward from Kuwait, for aviation already sitting at Camp Doha or Ali Al Salem
